given: A PR-review meeting whose meeting is pinned to the PR head SHA (meetings.pinned_sha); the code_intel graph answers at that pinned view.
when: A new push lands on the PR branch mid-meeting (a validated, GUID+SHA-deduped webhook), advancing the branch by 2 commits.
then: The freshness path full-rebuilds the graph off the new tip but the meeting keeps answering at its retained pinned SHA; a follow-up question is answered at the pin plus the honest 'the repo advanced 2 commits since this PR head' note — the pin is never silently mutated.
